# function: boolnum

Convert boolean to 0 or 1

Convert `false` to `0` and `true` to `1`.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
boolnum(value bool) number
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `value` (Boolean) bool to convert
